deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: The catalog names no GRE Subject test for physics.

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: Most physics graduate students hold teaching or research assistantships.
funding.quote: Most physics graduate students are supported by teaching or research assistantships

entry_route.value: The graduate school sets 72 hours for a PhD after a bachelor's and 42 after a master's, so both routes are open.
entry_route.quote: Students who do not hold a master’s degree will be required to complete a minimum of seventy-two hours of graduate credit

notes: Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
